requirements_summary: Orchard Health is evaluating Redwood to power patient-facing and internal clinician workflows. They expect PHI may be present in prompts/responses depending on use-case and are treating this as a regulated workload. They are procurement-led and require AWS Marketplace (ideally private offer) for purchase and renewal. Primary technical needs: predictable latency for patient portal chat, high throughput for batch summarization, and strong auditability for security review. They asked multiple times for a consolidated security packet they can forward to their risk committee.
workload_details: Phase 1: patient portal chat + message triage (interactive). Phase 2: clinical note summarization and doc search (asynchronous + embeddings). Expected usage: variable; initial pilot ~50k chat sessions/month; steady-state could be 10x. Needs streaming responses for chat. Interested in routing/fallback to maintain uptime during peak clinic hours.
compliance_and_security_notes: Healthcare compliance posture: Orchard security team requested SOC 2 Type II report access (under NDA) and ISO-aligned control overview; they also asked whether Redwood can sign a BAA for HIPAA workloads and which deployment modes support it. They want clarity on data handling defaults (prompt/response retention, logs, support access), encryption (in transit + at rest), and customer-managed key options (KMS). Audit logs must be exportable to their SIEM (they mentioned Splunk) with retention aligned to their policies. Residency preference: US-only. They asked for explicit shared responsibility language suitable for Marketplace security review.
procurement_notes: Orchard can only purchase through AWS Marketplace due to internal policy. They are pushing for an annual commit with clear SKU dimensions that map to their cost centers and want a private offer with standard terms. Timeline they gave: security risk committee review by early March; procurement submission mid-March; desired start date late March/early April. They requested that Redwood confirm onboarding flow steps (subscription → entitlement → org provisioning → API keys) and typical entitlement propagation delays so they can set expectations internally.
internal_notes: This account is very sensitive to wording. Avoid implying certifications beyond what we can substantiate; use approved security packet language and reference evidence access process. They will likely choose Dedicated or Private depending on PHI scope; keep Hosted API as a pilot option only if their security team approves. Strong signal: procurement already aligned on Marketplace path; biggest risk is security evidence turnaround + BAA/legal.
